analytics.dataSource: Binance public spot REST (https://data-api.binance.vision); closed 1h/4h klines
notes: Real closed Binance spot 1H/4H OHLCV; no fabricated history or trade execution.
Two fixed rules; no parameter optimization. 200 hourly bars warm up indicators; the next half initializes training, then three expanding-train / disjoint-test folds run chronologically.
All returns, win rate, drawdown and expectancy use percentage points; profit factor is a ratio. Expectancy is mean net trade return. Undefined win rate, profit factor or expectancy is null.

Equity, trade statistics, totalReturn and testReturn cover only concatenated nonoverlapping test folds. trainReturn is the arithmetic mean of overlapping expanding-training fold returns, never their sum.

Decisions use close t and only 4H candles closed by t; entries and signal exits use open t+1. Fee 10 bps plus adverse slippage 5 bps on each side. One unlevered position, all available cash, fractional quantities; exchange lot/tick rounding and capacity are not modeled.

Stop-first for ambiguous OHLC; gap-through stops use the worse open. No target fill on an entry bar. Stops remain active. Targets receive no favorable gap fill. Maximum hold 72 hours; predeclared fold boundaries flatten at the final bar open with both exit costs.
Drawdown uses hourly equity including estimated liquidation costs, not an intrabar worst-case path. No fees for idle cash, funding, shorting, leverage, tax or liquidity impact beyond fixed slippage.
Degradation and low-sample flags are descriptive; these short, single-symbol folds do not prove robustness, eliminate overfitting, or estimate a probability of future profit.
EMA 21/50 + RSI momentum: low sample (22 out-of-sample trades; warning threshold 30).
EMA 50 + RSI pullback: low sample (0 out-of-sample trades; warning threshold 30).

ruptures offline visualization: at most 1000 recent closed 1H log-return / absolute-return observations, full-window standardization, PELT l2 penalty 3*log(n), minimum segment 24 hours; terminal marker excluded. Never used for entries or validation.

River ADWIN receives abs(hourly log return)/0.05 clipped to [0,1], one closed candle at a time; no fitted full-sample scaling. driftDetected means at least one alert in the analyzed window; detection times: none. Drift is descriptive and does not enter strategy decisions.

pandas-ta-classic 0.8.32 independent native reference check after 200-bar warmup: EMA PASS (max absolute error 0; tolerance 8.72e-06); RSI PASS (max absolute error 3.55e-14; tolerance 1e-06). Differences are reported; the optional reference never replaces strategy inputs.
